Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)

ALLIANCE FOR AFFORDABLE ENERGY           yvonne@all4energy.org                                                            

Basis for Intervening:
The Alliance for Affordable Energy (AAE) requests to intervene in Docket ER26-3650, proposed tariff revisions filed by MISO regarding Interconnection Reliability Requirements for Large Loads. AAE is a consumer advocate for residential ratepayers in Louisiana, and member of the MISO Public Consumer Advocate Sector. This docket and activity has the potential to impact residential ratepayers in Louisiana, and therefore is of interest to AAE.
